errors.text_span: Започва със стойност приблизително 97.0 през януари 2023 г.
errors.evidence: Description states January 2023 starts at 97.0, but the figure shows around 95%.

errors.text_span: достига пик от около 99.0 през април 2023 г.
errors.evidence: Description states peak in April 2023 at 99.0, but the figure shows it around March 2023 with a value lower than 95%.

errors.text_span: спад до приблизително 87.0 през юни 2023 г.
errors.evidence: Description states decline to 87.0 in June 2023, but the figure shows it around March 2023 with a minimum near 82%.
Description mentions 93.0 in September 2023, but the line does not reach this value through 2023.
Description gives 91.0 for December 2023, but the plot shows around 78% in December 2023.
Description states 99.0 in April 2024, but figure shows a peak around 112% in February 2024.
The description omits the polynomial trend line and its equation and R² value shown in the figure.

errors.text_span: Етикетите са разположени през тримесечни интервали
errors.evidence: The description states labels are quarterly intervals, but they represent each month.
